observations: A second XenoDream process opened the disposable project without changing the preexisting process.
Selecting a batch source starts evaluation immediately.
The batch control changed from Select Files... to Cancel Batch.
No STL or OBJ file appeared in the controlled output directory.
The batch remained in evaluation for more than 90 seconds.
The automation process stopped responding and was force-closed.
The preexisting XenoDream process remained responsive.
XenoDream updated XenoDreamX.ini while the file dialog was used. The file contents were not captured because the file contains registration fields.
reason: The GUI automation reached native batch evaluation but did not reach export. The run does not distinguish a slow evaluation, a bad control sequence, or an application deadlock.
